messages:
Maya Patel: Quick check-in: we need final hero lines + CTA behavior for Hosted / Dedicated / Private so the benchmarks post and webinar have consistent links and routing. Can we land the copy and hidden UTM rules by Thursday?

Lina Torres: Agreed. Quick principle: Hosted = self-serve, low friction. Dedicated = hand-raise for performance. Private = sales-first with compliance docs.

Ethan Park: Proposed primary CTAs: Hosted = "Start hosted trial"; Dedicated = "Request dedicated demo"; Private = "Contact sales for private deployment". Secondary CTAs: benchmarks, case studies, or pricing.

Noah Kim: Routing specifics: Hosted -> signup flow (utm_source=site&utm_medium=hosted_cta). Dedicated -> /leads/dedicated with hidden `source=dedicated_site` and `estimated_qps` field. Private -> AE queue + auto-send compliance packet. I'll add `page_variant=hero_c` for A/B tracking.

Maya Patel: For the benchmark narrative and webinar, we'll compare p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens across: hosted runtime, dedicated quantized runs, and private on-prem baseline. Webinar title draft: "Production Inference: Choosing Hosted, Dedicated, or Private".

Jordan (growth-bot): :robot_face: I can pull an invite list: anyone who requested a dedicated demo or visited /pricing >45s in the last 6 months.

Lina Torres: Short hero options (pick one each):
Hosted: 
- "Build faster with a managed hosted inference API"
- "Hosted inference: fast, predictable, no infra"

Dedicated:
- "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput"
- "Dedicated pools with SLA-backed latency"

Private:
- "Deploy inference inside your VPC or on-prem"
- "Private deployments for compliance-sensitive apps"

Ethan Park: My picks: Hosted first option, Dedicated first option, Private second option.

Maya Patel: Good. Action items: Noah to implement form endpoints + UTM mapping, Ethan to run bench scripts and share CSVs, Lina to finalize hero copy and draft a 600-word launch post, Jordan to export invite list. Deadline Thursday EOD.

Noah Kim: I'll post the form mocks and exact UTM values by Wednesday.

Ethan Park: Bench runs scheduled Monday night. Will include quantized dedicated runs and a 4xV100 private baseline.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Reminder: avoid calling hosted "enterprise-ready" in hero — keep enterprise signals on Dedicated/Private. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
